decisions.reason: Although it complements managed communications, enterprise conferencing has become highly crowded and dominated by larger software ecosystems, making it less strategic than the firm's core network and infrastructure services.
Metropolitan data-centre connectivity remains closely tied to cloud growth, low-latency enterprise demand and the firm's owned network strengths, so it is attractive to retain.
Optical spectrum connectivity directly monetises the firm's fibre assets and fits its move toward high-bandwidth software-defined infrastructure services.

The voice number ordering portal supports automation and self-service for enterprise customers, but its narrower voice focus makes it somewhat more exposed than the firm's core data and connectivity offers.
